verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS ATS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Ashby offers a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of its core platform. The 'host your own careers page' via the public Job Posting API is a developer building block for a front-end page, not self-hosting the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
